info.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager
info.description: The vManage API exposes the functionality of operations maintaining devices and the overlay network
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 289 of 3815 upstream operations covering device inventory, device actions, device/general templates, device certificate management, alarms and device monitoring, user/group administration, centralized data-policy prefix and FQDN list builders, and vSmart centralized policy management (including activation and connectivity/push status). See the repo README for the full scope and the full spec.

sessionCookieAuth.name: JSESSIONID
sessionCookieAuth.description: vManage session cookie. Obtained out-of-band by POSTing form-encoded j_username/j_password credentials to /j_security_check and reading the JSESSIONID value from the response's Set-Cookie header. Itential Platform's dynamic-retrieval extension can only extract a token from a JSON response body, not a response header, so this value cannot be fetched automatically today -- it must be obtained manually (or via an external scheduled script) and kept current on the integration instance. Sessions expire after 30 minutes of inactivity or 24 hours total.

XsrfToken.name: X-XSRF-TOKEN
XsrfToken.description: Cross-site request forgery token, required on every state-changing request. Obtained out-of-band via GET /client/token using the session cookie above, and passed here on each call.
